criteria.title: Asked which doctors and specialists the customer must keep, and where they see them
criteria.judged_spec: The learner asked about current doctors and specialists, which ones matter most, and which office the customer visits.

criteria.title: Gathered every prescription with strength and dose
criteria.judged_spec: The learner asked for each prescription's name, strength and how often it is taken, and confirmed uncertain strengths.

criteria.title: Asked which pharmacy the customer uses
criteria.judged_spec: The learner asked which pharmacy or mail-order service the customer uses.

criteria.title: Asked about current and other coverage, including employer or retiree coverage
criteria.judged_spec: The learner asked about the current plan and any other coverage such as employer, retiree, Medigap, Medicaid, VA or TRICARE, and how a change would affect it.

criteria.title: Asked about specific health care needs
criteria.judged_spec: The learner asked about conditions, upcoming care and services the customer uses often.

criteria.title: Recorded needs match what the customer said
Scope of Appointment recorded before discussing other plans
criteria.judged_spec: The learner asked which products the customer wanted to discuss rather than assuming it.

criteria.title: TPMO disclaimer before any benefit discussion
criteria.judged_spec: The learner gave all three disclaimer elements, with the right numbers, before discussing any benefits. Use this to confirm paraphrases the element match missed.

criteria.title: Told the caller the call is recorded
Did not enroll while other coverage could be lost
Confirmed the election period and coverage start date
criteria.judged_spec: The learner explained that changes made now take effect January 1, 2027, and that the Annual Election Period ends December 7.

criteria.title: Must-keep practice verified in network, at the right office, on the outcome plan for 2027
Every prescription checked on the outcome plan at the right strength
Drug restrictions on the outcome plan seen and explained
criteria.judged_spec: The learner told the customer about prior authorization, step therapy or quantity limits on their drugs and what they mean.

criteria.title: Pharmacy network status checked on the outcome plan
Every coverage claim was backed by a lookup made before the claim
criteria.judged_spec: Find each statement that a provider, drug or pharmacy is covered or in network on a plan. Cite the utterance.

criteria.title: Outcome is acceptable for this customer
Compared the current plan with alternatives and stated gains and losses
criteria.judged_spec: The learner compared the current plan with any alternative and named what the customer would gain and give up.

criteria.title: Discussed costs of health care services
criteria.judged_spec: The learner discussed copays or coinsurance for services the customer uses.

criteria.title: Discussed premiums
criteria.judged_spec: The learner stated the plan premium and that the Part B premium continues.

criteria.title: Discussed benefits accurately, including conditions on supplemental benefits
criteria.judged_spec: The learner described benefits accurately and explained any eligibility conditions on supplemental benefits.

criteria.title: Tied the recommendation to the customer's needs
criteria.judged_spec: The learner explained the recommendation in terms of the customer's doctors, drugs, pharmacy, costs and priorities, without calling any plan best in general.

criteria.title: Pinned evidence matches the plan, year and office
Summary of Benefits for the submitted plan opened before submission
Pre-Enrollment Checklist reviewed before submission
criteria.judged_spec: The learner went through the checklist items with the customer rather than only opening the document.

criteria.title: Enrollment consent documented from a heard customer yes
Application matches the customer record
PCP collected exactly when the plan requires one
Used plain language and checked understanding
criteria.judged_spec: The learner avoided jargon or explained it, and checked that the customer understood key points.

criteria.title: Respected the customer's choice without pressure
criteria.judged_spec: The learner presented options and let the customer decide, including keeping the current plan or waiting.

criteria.title: Corrected misconceptions
criteria.judged_spec: The learner noticed and gently corrected anything the customer misremembered or misunderstood.

criteria.title: Follow-up scheduled before the deadline when the decision was deferred
Notes record the reason, rationale and next steps
criteria.judged_spec: The saved notes state why the customer called, what was found, the decision and its rationale, and next steps.
